job.title: AI Product & Delivery Lead
job.description:
AI Product and Delivery Lead

Permanent | £95,000–£115,000
Location: London | Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 remote)
Travel: Occasional travel to other UK offices and client sites

We’re partnering with an organisation to appoint an AI Product and Delivery Lead who can turn an ambitious internal AI roadmap into tools and workflows people use.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining product judgement, technical delivery and building. You’ll decide what should be developed, direct engineering priorities and create prototypes, internal tools and automations yourself. The focus is on building a connected set of capabilities that delivers lasting value, rather than isolated solutions.

The Opportunity

You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day direction and delivery of an internal AI programme, working closely with the Strategy Director. You’ll have the authority to prioritise, reshape or stop work within the agreed roadmap, balancing stakeholder needs with what can be delivered.

You’ll set priorities for one dedicated software engineer and have access to substantial support from a second engineer. You’ll also work alongside an AI Adoption Consultant to make sure the tools being built can be adopted and maintained across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for:


  • Owning the AI roadmap and backlog, deciding what to prioritise and what not to pursue.

  • Directing engineering delivery, setting clear priorities and making practical decisions about scope and trade-offs.

  • Building and shipping prototypes, internal tools and automations yourself.

  • Working with stakeholders to understand problems, challenge requests and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Setting standards for a shared knowledge base and skills library so new AI work builds on existing capabilities.

  • Acting as deputy owner of AI governance, including acceptable use, data classification and controls for agentic AI.

  • Supporting selected client discovery and pre-sales activity alongside the primarily internal remit.

About You

You’ll have at least three years of experience in product management, technology delivery, consulting or digital transformation, including work you’ve seen through to live use. You’ll also bring:


  • Evidence of tools, products or workflows you’ve built, and the ability to explain the decisions behind them.

  • Daily practical use of generative AI and confidence with AI-assisted development tools.

  • Sound product judgement and the confidence to defend priorities and trade-offs under challenge.

  • The technical understanding to work credibly with engineers and question assumptions when needed.

  • The ability to say no to senior stakeholders and explain why.

  • Confidence working with incomplete information and defining a practical way forward without a detailed specification.

Experience with commercial generative AI, automation or data products would be useful. Familiarity with APIs, agents, MCP, retrieval, evaluation, managed services or B2B technology would also be welcome, but is not essential.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI programme, with the authority to shape its direction and the scope to build as well as lead delivery.

In return, you’ll benefit from:


  • A salary of £95,000–£115,000, with the upper end reflecting the ability to run the function independently within the first quarter.

  • Hybrid working, with two days per week in the London office and three days remote.

  • Dedicated engineering support and the freedom to make day-to-day roadmap decisions.

  • A role focused primarily on internal transformation, with some involvement in client discovery and pre-sales.

  • A hands-on remit with no revenue target.

The interview process includes an introductory conversation, a technical task worked through live rather than completed at home, and one or two further interviews.

The Opportunity

As a Business Validation Analyst, you’ll research and assess businesses to establish their legitimacy and confirm that their identity, trading activity and brand representation are accurate.

The role covers two key stages: pre-validation and validation. You’ll initially receive comprehensive training and support, progressing into the full validation process as your knowledge, confidence and consistency develop.

The technology platform gathers and presents much of the relevant information, but you’ll be responsible for interpreting it, conducting additional research where necessary and applying sound judgement to reach evidence-based conclusions.

During pre-validation, you’ll establish whether an applicant is the registered business it claims to be by:

  • Checking company records, websites, addresses, contact details and trading names.
  • Using reliable independent sources to verify the information provided.
  • Identifying connections between registered businesses, trading names and consumer-facing brands.
  • Investigating discrepancies across company information, websites, addresses and contact details.
  • Building a clear and comprehensive evidence trail to support your findings.

As you progress into the wider validation process, you’ll also be responsible for:

  • Reviewing company records, accounts, ownership structures and directors.
  • Conducting sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEP) and adverse-media screening.
  • Reviewing websites, privacy policies, terms and conditions and domain information.
  • Assessing email addresses, logos and brand names to establish credible connections.
  • Investigating franchise, group-company and trading-name relationships.
  • Identifying and investigating gaps, inconsistencies and potential risks.

  • Distinguishing genuine screening matches from unrelated businesses or individuals with similar names.

Applications are also welcomed from strong researchers in other professional backgrounds who can demonstrate excellent attention to detail, judgement and written communication skills.

Telecommunications experience is not required.

  • Confident identifying inconsistencies and recognising when further investigation is required.

  • Confident using browser-based systems and navigating multiple information sources.
  • Reliable, discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
  • Open to feedback and keen to develop your knowledge across the complete validation process.

French or German language skills would be advantageous, as would experience living or working in France or Germany. Familiarity with local business practices, brands, address formats and naming conventions, or previous experience working with international businesses, would also be beneficial. However, these are not essential requirements.

As Security Test Co-Ordinator, you’ll take responsibility for the end-to-end coordination of security testing activities, ensuring scope, objectives, timelines, resources and prerequisites are clearly established before testing begins.
You’ll act as a central point between stakeholders, testers and suppliers, helping to remove blockers, manage dependencies and ensure findings progress effectively through triage, remediation, retesting and closure.
